description: Jennifer Davis for Congress is focused on bringing practical, common-sense leadership to Washington. Jennifer is a wife, mom of 10, entrepreneur, and technology business leader who built a successful company from the ground up right here in Illinois. Jennifer’s vision for stronger families, economic opportunity, support for small businesses, safer communities, and policies that help hardworking Americans thrive. Learn about her background, priorities, and ways to support the campaign.
